title: Tech Collective LLC pink-and-gold business website with services and contact intake

requirements.text: Create a responsive marketing website for “Tech Collective LLC” with clear navigation and sections for: Hero/intro, Services, About, and Contact.

quotes: Create a business website for the tech collective llc.

acceptanceCriteria: Landing page renders without errors and is usable on mobile and desktop.
Top navigation allows jumping to Hero, Services, About, and Contact sections.
Brand name “Tech Collective LLC” is visible in the header and hero.

requirements.text: Add a Services section that lists and describes the currently offered services: Notarial services; Simple phone configuration & setup; Website creation; Tech consultations.

quotes: My dervues currently offered are notarial and simple phone configuration and set up. Website creation and tech consultations.

acceptanceCriteria: Services section contains exactly the four services named by the user.
Each service has a short, readable description in English.
Services are presented in a clean layout (e.g., cards or a grid) and remain readable on mobile.

requirements.text: Apply a consistent pink-and-gold visual theme across the site (colors, typography, buttons, section styling), ensuring sufficient contrast and accessibility.

quotes: I want it pink and gold

acceptanceCriteria: Primary accents use pink and gold consistently across header, buttons, and highlights.
Text contrast meets basic readability (no light text on light backgrounds).
Theme is applied consistently across all sections (no default/un-styled components).

requirements.text: Add a Contact section with a simple inquiry form (name, email/phone, service interested in, message) and a clear confirmation state after submission.

quotes: Create a business website for the tech collective llc.

acceptanceCriteria: User can enter contact details, select a service of interest, and submit a message.
After submit, the UI shows a success confirmation and clears or disables the form appropriately.
Form includes basic validation (required fields and valid email format when email is provided).

requirements.text: Persist submitted contact inquiries in the Motoko backend and expose query methods to retrieve them for display in a simple internal “Inquiries” view/page (no external email integration).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores each inquiry with timestamp and submitted fields.
Frontend includes an “Inquiries” view/page that lists stored inquiries in a readable table/list.
Submitting a new inquiry makes it appear in the inquiries list after refresh/reload (or via refetch).

requirements.text: Generate and add static brand imagery (logo and a hero background/illustration) in a cohesive pink-and-gold style, and render them in the site header/hero from frontend static assets (not via backend).

quotes: I want it pink and gold

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI.
Header displays the logo and hero section uses the hero image tastefully without harming readability.
Images load correctly in production build and do not require backend calls.

required: Minimalist tech-inspired logo in pink and gold on transparent background (tech-collective-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Abstract gradient hero background with subtle circuitry pattern in pink and gold (hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
Set of 4 small line-style service icons in pink/gold: notary, phone setup, website creation, tech consultation (service-icons-sprite.dim_512x128.png)
